summary: Frontend-only iteration 4 review: visual/animation pass + one-line HIW title fix. All animation primitives verified working (Tilt, CountUp, LiveTicker, ScrollProgress, ReviewMarquee, hero-mesh, bg-accent glow, skeleton loaders, dark mode, reduced-motion). HIW title renders on exactly 1 line at all 4 target widths. Only findings: (a) favicon <link rel=icon> not present in rendered DOM (browser still loads /favicon.svg via default path since it exists — 200) — likely %PUBLIC_URL% substitution issue in CRA build; (b) 24 401 console errors on public homepage from unauthenticated calls to protected endpoints (non-blocking, pre-existing). Regression E2E (login/quote/payment) NOT executed per iteration scope — animation-only pass.

ui_bugs.issue: <link rel="icon" href="%PUBLIC_URL%/favicon.svg"> is present in source but NOT in rendered DOM head (only 3 font <link> tags exist). /favicon.svg endpoint returns 200, so browser fallback works, but the explicit tag is missing. Verify %PUBLIC_URL% is being substituted at build time.

action_items: (Optional) Investigate why <link rel=icon> is missing from rendered DOM even though index.html contains it — check CRA build output / %PUBLIC_URL% substitution. Favicon works via /favicon.svg default fallback so this is low priority.

(Optional) Silence 24 x 401 console errors on public pages: unauthenticated homepage triggers requests to auth-guarded endpoints (returns 401). Consider guarding these calls or catching to keep console clean.
critical_code_review_comments: Home.jsx makes GET /categories on mount which is fine, but if user visits homepage while logged-out, other components on public layout appear to call authenticated endpoints producing 401s — worth an audit to avoid cluttered devtools console.
Favicon <link> tag not appearing in DOM should be validated by inspecting the built public/index.html emitted to CDN.
test_credentials: Used /app/memory/test_credentials.md context — auth flow not exercised this iteration (visual pass).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 4 verified all animation features from the review spec. HIW title h1 measured single-line at 1920/1280/768/390 (heights 48/48/40/36 px matching one line-height). Category cards use data-testid='cat-card-<slug>' (8 present); Tilt wrapper applies matrix3d transform on hover as expected. bg-accent buttons show rgba(37,99,235,0.55) box-shadow on hover (glow works). Live ticker text rotates ~every 4s. Scroll-progress width grows from ~366 → ~502 px on mid-scroll. service-skeleton-0 is catchable at DOMContentLoaded on /services. Dark mode toggles html.className='dark'. Regression E2E payment flow (customer→provider→quote→Stripe 4242) was NOT retested since spec was frontend-visual only; backend was untouched per user brief.
